title: Easy Homemade Bagels

steps.title: Activate yeast
steps.text: In a large bowl, mix {water} warm water and {sugar} sugar. Sprinkle {yeast} active dry yeast on top. Let sit 5–10 minutes until foamy.

steps.title: Mix dough
steps.text: Add {flour} bread flour and {salt} salt. Mix, then knead 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic.

steps.title: First rise
steps.text: Place in a greased bowl, cover with a towel, rise 1 hour until doubled.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Punch down, divide into 8–10 pieces. Roll each into a ball, poke a hole in the center and stretch into a bagel shape.

steps.title: Second rise
steps.text: Rest on a floured surface, covered, 15–20 minutes.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Bring {boilwater} water and {honey} honey to a gentle boil. Boil each bagel 1–2 minutes per side. Remove with a slotted spoon to a lined sheet.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 425°F for 20–25 minutes until golden brown.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool on a wire rack before slicing.

omnicook_steps.title: Activate yeast
omnicook_steps.text: Add {water} warm water, {sugar} sugar and {yeast} yeast. Rest 5 minutes until foamy.

omnicook_steps.title: Knead
omnicook_steps.text: Add {flour} bread flour and {salt} salt. Kneading preset.

omnicook_steps.title: Rise, shape, boil, bake
omnicook_steps.text: Continue with First rise through Cool as written (off the machine).

tips: Bread flour gives a chewier texture.
Boiling is what makes the classic crust; don't skip it.
For extra shine, brush boiled bagels with egg wash before baking.
Store airtight up to 3 days, or freeze.
flags: Card's ounce figures for yeast (0.56 oz) and salt (0.6 oz) don't match 2¼ tsp and 1 tsp; using the spoon amounts.
OmniCook dough here is about 37 oz, near the 40 oz max.

title: Almond Flour Chocolate Chip Cookies
blurb: Gluten-free. Soft centers, golden edges. Mix in the OmniCook, fold chips by hand, bake in the oven.

omnicook_steps.title: Make the wet base
omnicook_steps.text: Heat off. Add {butter} softened butter, {brown} packed brown sugar, {gran} granulated sugar, {egg} and {vanilla} vanilla. Mix until smooth.

omnicook_steps.title: Add the dry
omnicook_steps.text: Add {almond} almond flour, {soda} baking soda and {salt} salt.

omnicook_steps.title: Scrape and pulse
omnicook_steps.text: Stop the blade, scrape down the bowl, then mix in 5-second bursts until just combined.

omnicook_steps.title: Fold in the chips
omnicook_steps.text: Move the dough to a bowl and stir in {chips} chocolate chips by hand.

omnicook_steps.title: Heat the oven
omnicook_steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.

omnicook_steps.title: Scoop
omnicook_steps.text: Scoop and roll 1½-tbsp balls. Space them 2 inches apart.

omnicook_steps.title: Bake
omnicook_steps.text: Bake 10–11 minutes, until the edges are just slightly golden.

omnicook_steps.title: Cool
omnicook_steps.text: Cool on the sheet a few minutes, then move gently to a rack.

steps.text: Stir in {almond} almond flour, {soda} baking soda and {salt} salt until just combined.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.

steps.title: Scoop
steps.text: Scoop and roll 1½-tbsp balls. Space them 2 inches apart.

steps.title: Bake

steps.title: Cool

tips: Don't wait for firm centers. Pull them when the edges are just golden; they keep setting on the hot sheet.
flags: Card gives no yield; ~24 cookies is an estimate from 1½-tbsp scoops.
